$comment: D-ASM-MEMORY-CONSTRAINT-REFUSED-DESPITE-BEING-DECLARED: the first runnable witness that the `"m"` MEMORY constraint reaches the template. ★★★ THIS EXAMPLE WAS BORN RED — before the fix it did not compile at all, on either target, at either config: `__asm__("movl %1, %0" : "=r"(r) : "m"(*p))` was refused with `error[H0009] … operand 1 (constraint "m") has no resolved register class — the constraint letter was never bound to a processor`, about a letter BOTH shipped targets declare (`{ "letter": "m", "binds": "operandKind", "operandKind": "membase" }`). gcc 13.3.0 compiles the same source on both (✔MEASURED: `nop (%rdi)` on x86_64, `nop [x0]` on aarch64), and one working reference makes the behaviour required. ★★★ WHY THE EXIT CODE IS A RESULT AND NOT A STRUCTURE PIN: `"m"` differs from `"r"` in exactly one way — the bound register holds the operand's ADDRESS, not its value — and a regression that lowered the VALUE instead still compiles rc=0, still emits a memory form and still assembles. It just dereferences an int as a pointer. That is a wild read with no diagnostic anywhere, so the only instrument that can see it is EXECUTION. ★★ THREE SHAPES, EACH A DIFFERENT PATH TO THE SAME BINDING: (1) the address arrives as a PARAMETER (a register value, behind a call); (2) the address is a FRAME OFFSET on a local, lowered directly in `main` — the shape the optimizer can see through, which is why the `release` arm is mandatory rather than decorative; (3) the SYMBOLIC `%[name]` spelling, which reaches the binding through a second row pointing at the same register — a memory form that travelled only on the positional row would be red on shape 3 alone. Each shape returns its own exit code (1/2/3), so a failure names which path broke instead of collapsing to a single 1. ⚠ WHY THE aarch64 ARM USES `long`: `ldr %w0, %1` is the natural 32-bit spelling and `%w` is an operand MODIFIER that no shipped target declares a width-view vocabulary for; the semantic tier refuses it fail-loud (D-CSUBSET-INLINE-ASM-OPERANDS) rather than running the load at the wrong width. ⚠ THE `volatile` SEED IS LOAD-BEARING for its sibling `c_inline_asm_operands`' reason: without it release folds the value to a constant before lowering, silently changing which mechanism each arm tests.
